move: split title meets at seam, halves part to reveal product, slam shut
how: Two dark half-panels cover the frame; the two halves of a word slide in from x:∓300 with expo.out to meet at a centre seam that draws with scaleY. At 0.29D the halves part (xPercent ∓100, expo.inOut 1.1s), revealing a video behind that eases from scale 1.3 to 1.05, and a product card flips in from scale 0.7, rotateY:30 with back.out(1.4); its text rises with expo.out stagger and a conic-gradient chip spins in. The card floats (y:-10, rotateY:-5, sine.inOut) through 0.78D, then at 0.89D the halves slam shut with expo.in, title text is reset, and the seam collapses to close the loop.
adapt: Swap the two word halves, sub-labels, the background video and the product card contents/colours; keep the 1.1s expo.inOut part and the 0.45s expo.in slam.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .behind video, .product, .cap, two .half panels and .seam, waiting on loadeddata; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the video-scrub onUpdate tween and offsets as fractions of D (open 1.75/6, card 2.05/6, shut 5.35/6). Scope selectors to el.
caveats: video scrub via currentTime requires loaded media
from() tweens need immediateRender:false when rebuilt
